Consequently, a method based on machine learning (ML) technique that directly affects the GPP by leveraging external elements such as remotely sensed data, geographic data, and meteorological data. We propose a random forest model that had an R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> value of 0.82 for estimating GPP based on 10-fold cross-validation, in the Australian region, and the findings are contrasted with those obtained using current state-of-the-art techniques like SVM and XGBoost. Performance of future prediction has been demonstrated by predicting the GPP for year 2014 for which the R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> value attained 0.84 with respect to the ground truth, whereas the MODIS GPP was only 0.52. Therefore, these characteristics can be used to model the GPP and can forecast values across a range of time scales and with varied levels of spatial detail.

articleTitle: TinyML-Based Gait Recognition for User Detection on an STM32L4 IoT Node
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Gait recognition stands out as a robust biometric tool for discerning users. Yet, adapting it to devices with limited resources, such as the STM32L4 microcontroller, demands cutting-edge strategies. This research unveils an innovative TinyML methodology, leveraging a specially-designed Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Notably, our bespoke CNN model showcased a remarkable 97.3% accuracy in pinpointing users on the STM32L4 system.

articleTitle: An Efficient Deep Learning-based VGG19 Approach for Rice Leaf Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: As the staple crop and commodity par excellence, rice deserves close scrutiny throughout its lifetime from production through consumption. This is especially true in countries like India. A major threat to the health of rice plants in general as well as their yield is that they are susceptible to a variety of diseases. This is a big step forward in rice leaf disease classification. The use of the an efficient and fine-tuned VGG19 model helps to achieve an extremely high accuracy rate (over 97.5%). This highlights the capabilities of modern deep learning methods, an important breakthrough for the agriculture field. There was a very complex equation in the relationship between epochs and model performance, as probed by careful exploration. Despite this, an epoch of 28 showed the highest efficiency and a set of 7 displayed suboptimal results. At epoch 28 the proposed approach reached a testing loss of 0.0253, verifying its adeptness in distinguishing healthy from diseased rice leaves. This research is based on an integrated theory of image analysis that includes the different conditions and stages in the development of rice plants. Taking a holistic view brings rice leaf health conditions into focus. In conclusion, this study is an important step forward in the field of rice leaf disease classification with state-of-the-art deep learning techniques that greatly improve accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of Low Power High-Speed LMS Adaptive Filter For Biomedical Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic continues to impact communities worldwide. Patients suffered from COVID-19 are at increased risk of a broad range of cardiovascular disorders. An electrocardiogram (ECG) is a simple test which graphically represents the heart’s rhythm and the electrical activity of the heart during a cardiac cycle. Therefore, precise detection of electrocardiogram signals is the elementary step in clinical diagnostics. This research paper presents an implementation of an adaptive Least Mean Squared (LMS) digital filter for trustworthy ECG signal detection. The work aims at Multiple Constant Multiplication (MCM) operations and Common Sub-expression Elimination (CSE) techniques to improve precision and reduce power consumption. The filter is modeled using Verilog hardware descriptive language and implemented on Xilinx ML605 FPGA (XC6VLX240T1FFG1156 FPGA) Embedded Development Kit. Comparison with the direct implementation of LMS filter DFG shows that the number of employed FPGA LUTs is reduced by 65.53%, power consumption is reduced by 55.98%, frequency of operation of the device is increased by 52.88%, and the throughput is increased by 159.14%. The results show reduced power consumption and corrected accuracy, suggesting that the proposed method is capable of accurately detecting ECG signals.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Deepfake Detection Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Deepfakes, which leverage advanced machine learning techniques such as generative adversarial networks (GANs), pose a significant threat to the integrity of visual content and raise concerns about misinformation and identity theft. This research provides a comparative analysis of various deepfake detection models, aiming to dissect their strengths and weaknesses. Notable architectures like Xception and ResNet50 exhibit high accuracy, precision, and recall with minimal gender bias. However, the Swin Transformer, while excelling in fake image detection, faces challenges with real images, suggesting potential bias. The CNN model demonstrates subpar performance, emphasizing limitations in classifying both fake and real images effectively. MobileNet shows moderate overall performance but maintains balanced precision and recall. The study recommends an ensemble approach to combine model strengths and address individual weaknesses. Future work should focus on refining model architectures, exploring ensemble strategies, and mitigating biases in real image detection.

articleTitle: Crowd Anomaly Detection and Performance Evaluation using YOLO Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In recent years, the YOLO object detection algorithm has gained significant attention due to its superior accuracy and efficiency compared to counter algorithms. This research paper particularly aims to test the YOLOv5 algorithm on various images to detect various objects and compare the same with the YOLOv3 model. This paper also discusses various parameters based on which the algorithm’s efficiency is determined. Our experimental results show that YOLOv5 achieves higher accuracy with low processing speed. The highest accuracy attained by YOLOv5 is 0.99 with F1 score of 0.9. The paper has ability to provide valuable information to the future researchers.

articleTitle: Bi-directional GRU-Based Approach for Multi-Class Text Error Identification System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In today's highly competitive academic and research landscape, the impression authors leave on readers is paramount to their reputation and success. Spelling errors can significantly undermine an author's credibility and negatively impact their standing within the scholarly community. To mitigate this risk, it is imperative that authors thoroughly proofread their content before submitting it to prestigious conference journals or sharing it with fellow researchers. This paper introduces a novel solution to streamline the error-checking process and empower authors to focus on other critical aspects of their projects. We propose a sophisticated text classification model, leveraging the vast capabilities of the Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) architecture, which was trained on the extensive C4 dataset sourced from the TensorFlow Library. This model exhibits exceptional proficiency in rectifying spelling mistakes across a wide range of contexts, thereby bolstering the overall quality and clarity of written work. Notably, our text classification model trained with Bi-Directional GRU method showcases a remarkable accuracy of 67% in classifying errors into four distinct categories, providing insightful feedback to authors for further improvement.

articleTitle: Multi speaker diarization and speech recognition using ECAPA-TDNN and pyannote-v2.1
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Speech recognition converts spoken words into text, which powers accessibility tools and virtual assistants. Speaker diarization is the process of identifying and labeling speakers in audio. In order to improve speech recognition accuracy and facilitate efficient clustering in speaker diarization, speaker embeddings are used to capture distinctive voice characteristics. The ECAPA-TDNN model extracts strong speaker embeddings using a channel- and context-dependent attention mechanism, Squeeze-Excitation, and residual blocks. The pyannote.audio toolkit provides a speaker diarization pipeline based on local speaker segmentation, neural speaker embedding, and global agglomerative clustering. This paper presents a novel approach for speaker diarization and speech recognition using two pre-trained models: the ECAPA-TDNN model and the pyannote.audio version 2.1 toolkit. The paper demonstrates the effectiveness of combining these two models on the AMI meeting dataset and various types of audio streams. The proposed system outperforms existing methods in speaker diarization in terms of performance and robustness.

articleTitle: “Revolutionizing Aviation and EV Industries: Advancements in Axial Flux Motors for Electric Propulsion Systems with ANSYS Electronics”
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This exploration delves into the transformative impact of axial flux motors and electric propulsion systems in the aviation and electric vehicle (EV) industries. Distinguished from traditional radial flux motors, axial flux motors offer advantages like higher power density, improved efficiency, and enhanced torque characteristics. The integration of ANSYS Electronics Software is essential for precise simulations, optimizing motor performance, and overcoming challenges like thermal management and electromagnetic interference. Through case studies, the paper showcases the software’s effectiveness in addressing industry-specific hurdles. As the demand for sustainable transportation rises, the research emphasizes the crucial role of axial flux motors and electric propulsion systems, with ANSYS Electronics Software serving as a key enabler. The objective is to inspire further innovation and collaboration within the engineering community, fostering the evolution of electric propulsion technologies.

articleTitle: De-speckling of Synthetic Aperture Radar Image using Hybrid Filtering Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: For SAR de-speckling, two hybrid filtering algorithms based on the bilateral filter (BF), edge-based adaptive mean filter (EAM) and non-local mean filter (NLM) are presented in this work. The non-local filtering principle is used to choose the neighborhood that will be used for the estimation of the filtered pixels. The suggested system performances are evaluated and contrasted with current SAR de-speckling techniques. According to the results, the proposed hybrid filters outperformed the Frost and Median filters in terms of reducing speckles and preserving edge detail.

articleTitle: Text Summarization for Research Papers using Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Scientific research frequently begins with a thorough review of the body of previous work, which includes a wide range of publications. This study process might be shortened by automatically summarizing scientific publications, which would be of great use to researchers. Because scientific papers have a different structure and require citation phrases, summarizing them presents different issues than summarizing other forms of literature. Furthermore, algorithmic pseudocode, figures, tables, and other elements not typically present in generic text, often contain valuable content that is not readily visible in plain language. Our Research Paper assistant presents a comprehensive investigation into the development and analysis of the summary of a complex research paper leveraging a robust sequential model (seq2seq) using the Transformer model. We are performing a comparison between Extractive and Abstractive approaches as well to prove that this work highlights the necessity of Abstractive summary methodologies in research paper summarization, acknowledging the drawbacks of extractive methods. The complex structure and substance of research publications might be missed by extraction approaches, which results in a loss of context and coherence. Conversely, Abstractive summarization techniques provide an answer by producing unique, short, and cohesive text in addition to picking and rearranging sentences. In order to efficiently condense the huge amount of information and insights contained in research articles while preserving readability and informativeness, this shift towards Abstractive summarization is essential.

articleTitle: Design of 32-Function- 32-Bit Arithmetic and Logical Unit (ALU)
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: An Arithmetic logic Unit (ALU) is used in arithmetic, logical function in all processor. It is also an important subsystem in digital system design. Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) is one of the most important components of any system and is used in many appliances like calculators, cell phones, and computers. A 32-bit ALU was designed using Verilog HDL and 32 functions were implemented using 5 select lines. Along with the primitive arithmetic and logical operations, shifting, parity checkers, increment and decrement operations, and code converters are included in this design.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Social Media Comments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: With the development in technology and introduction of Web 2.0, Social Media Applications had a great role in connecting people from across the globe. The popular way of sharing opinions on the internet became the comment section. As every coin has two sides, misuse of the comments section was inevitable. Some comments contained hateful or extremist content against certain people or communities. These comments need to be deleted or prevented to maintain sanity on social forums. With the help of Sentiment Analysis technique, we can filter all the inappropriate comments, and flag the user. This solution is tested and running successfully on a Social Media Clone Application. The dataset used for training the model is an IMDb dataset. The data collected is then pre-processed, removing all the HTML tag elements. Then it is passed to the SVM based Machine Learning Model to train it. After the model has been trained, it is used to find whether the comment posted on the application is positive or negative. The comment, if passed all checks, is allowed to be posted. The negative comments are deleted and the user is flagged for being inappropriate. Thus this solution can be applied to multiple social forums and websites, contributing to a healthy social environment.

articleTitle: Integrating Soil Sensing and Rainfall Modelling for Precision Crop Recommendation Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This research article offers a sophisticated machine learning-based method for altitude, temperature, pressure, sunshine, rainfall, nutrients, and soil moisture data-driven soil state, and crop type analysis. The dataset is rigorously preprocessed, with seaborn used to visualize and handle null values. The process behind the article explains the four soil states of soil according to the encoding of categorical output classes: dry, very dry, wet, and very wet. Several crop types are to be predicted depending on the parameters taken. Random Forest Classifier, Decision tree, KNN, and Naive Bayes models were trained with accuracies of respectively, following data normalization and splitting into training and testing sets. This work demonstrates how machine learning can effectively classify soil conditions, which opens up new possibilities for agricultural and environmental management applications.

articleTitle: Galaxy Type Classification With Sub-categorization Using Deep Learning Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper presents a robust approach to galaxy categorization utilizing machine learning and image processing techniques, emphasizing Galaxy Zoo and Galaxy10 datasets. The MobileNetV2 architecture is used for feature extraction on a training dataset of 4100 labeled photos. At the same time, image pre-processing procedures ensure dataset standardization. After 20 epochs, the model reaches an overall accuracy of 91%, indicating its usefulness in categorizing galaxies into Elliptical, Spiral, and Irregular types, as well as detailed subclassifications such as E0, E3, E7 for elliptical galaxies and Normal Spiral, Barred Spiral for spiral galaxies. The subclassification models use image processing to extract morphological traits, demonstrating the possibility for automated study of astronomical information and contributing to advances in astrophysics research.

articleTitle: Anthracnose Detection and Classification in Chilli Leaves Using Mobile Net: UAV Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The health of a plant has remained an indispensable factor for sustainable and enriching crop production to fulfill the Nation’s food demands. A degradation in the health of the crop leads to low crop yields. Out of a wide range of factors affecting the health of the crop the most concerning factor remains the plant diseases and pests. More than 50% of India’s population is engaged in agricultural practices. In the agricultural sector, India is among the top 3 exporters of Dried Chilli. However, Chilli exports have faced a descent in recent years owing to crop yield loss due to diseases caused by fungi or pests. Anthracnose is the most prevalent disease in Chilli plants. The process of anthracnose disease detection in Chilli crops is a tedious process due to a lack of laboratory facilities and expertise. Such a situation demands for development of an ‘automated detection of anthracnose disease in Chilli plant’ system which puts the process of early and precise detection of plant disease at ease. Computer Vision advancements make it possible for automatic disease detection using visible symptoms on the crop. Keeping this in view, this paper proposes an automated model for the detection of anthracnose in the Chilli plant using a Mobile Net-based convolutional neural network (CNN). Over the last few years researchers such as Boulent et al. stated in their article that the integration of aerial image data and AI-based methods holds promise for offering an effective, high-throughput technique for detecting plant diseases in real-world conditions. Hence the dataset utilized for our model is aerial images using UAV (unnamed aerial vehicle). The proposed system for anthracnose detection in Chilli developed using Mobile Net achieved an accuracy of 99.6%.

articleTitle: Parkinson's Disease Diagnosis from Patients Speech Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Parkinson's disease is a neurological disorder mostly observed in the population over the age of 60 years. Over 8.5 million people world-wide are affected by it. Early diagnosis of the disease helps take preventive and curative measures to enable the affected individuals to lead a normal life. Quality of speech is one of the key indicators for identification of the disease.In this study, we investigate the effectiveness of multiple machine learning algorithms on various speech related attributes to determine the existence of this disease. Additionally, we identify the crucial features which impact the model's functioning. The study employs Explainable AI (XAI) to investigate the influence of voice features on the research outcomes. The experimental findings showcase a diagnostic accuracy of 95% using Random Forest & XGBoost classifiers. We, using SHAP, identify that 6 features out of a set of 24 provide the best efficiency of diagnosis.

articleTitle: Data Poisoning Attacks in Cognitive Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Data poisoning attacks pose a significant threat to the integrity of machine learning (ML) models, impacting their ability to generate accurate predictions. This research delves into the realm of adversarial ML [1], specifically focusing on poisoning attacks [4] during the training phase. A taxonomy of adversarial ML techniques is presented, classifying poisoning attacks into different categories. Real-world examples, including incidents involving Google's VirusTotal [8] scanning service, highlight the practical implications of data poisoning. The study explores defense mechanisms such as training data sanitization and robust optimization, acknowledging the nuanced balance required between model robustness and accuracy. The paper concludes with recommendations for safeguarding ML models against evolving adversarial threats, underscoring the ongoing importance of vigilance and education in the cybersecurity landscape.

articleTitle: Digitalising Handwritten Hindi Documents Using Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The character classification for handwritten documents has many challenges since each individual write with different font, has a different style of writing and writes with fontsize. This unconventional style poses a challenge to traditional techniques like Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and the solutions exists at the level of recognizing the character and a word. Through this project, author extends it for entire document digitalization thus helping to preserve the important documents written in Hindi. The authors used Convolution Neural Network models to address the challenge and were able to achieve 99.19% accuracy in classifying the characters.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of Virtual Realityin Improving Learning Outcomes for Children with Autism
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This research paper explores the efficacy of a virtual reality (VR) environment in enhancing learning outcomes for children with autism through a game-based approach. The study uses VR technology to create a more immersive and tailored educational experience for autistic children. The implications of this study are substantial, as they introduce a new and comprehensive approach to education for autistic children. The findings on the synergy between VR technology and personalized learning offer insights into how these components contribute to improved learning outcomes and increased engagement. As VR technology progresses, this research examines how VR can be effectively utilized as an inclusive educational strategy for children with autism.

articleTitle: Agrifficient - Synergizing Agro Insights through Advanced Analytics and Imaging Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The approximate average loss faced by farmers in India due to insufficient knowledge of crop suitability is around 50%, though this figure varies significantly based on the specific crop and regional factors. Plant diseases result in a substantial reduction of 15% to 25% in the potential crop yield in India. This project proposed Agrifficient (Crop recommendation, Fertilizer recommendation and Plant disease detection) system which aims to help Indian farmers select the best crops based on soil characteristics, temperature and rainfall. It helps them select suitable fertilizer and detect plant disease. It gives them the option to fetch the information in Regional languages. Agriculture is of utmost importance in the Indian economy, impacting both rural and urban livelihoods. Many farmers rely on intuition or traditional practices when choosing crops, potentially leading to financial losses. The system leverages machine learning to provide data-driven crop recommendations, improving decision-making and contributing to the stability and growth of the agricultural sector.Given the vital role of agriculture in the Indian economy, this system offers valuable guidance, helping farmers move beyond traditional practices and make informed decisions. Employing machine learning techniques, the system leverages historical data on factors like nitrogen(N), phosphorous(P), potassium(K), pH, State, City and rainfall to predict suitable crops for the current weather conditions, thereby enhancing the agricultural sector’s economic growth and employment opportunities. It also aids farmers in soil quality assessment to determine what contents are high and low in the crop and recommends fertilizers, considering N, P, K and the crop for improved performance. It also detects plant disease by taking in images as input. This project is designed to empower both experienced and novice farmers by providing valuable insights into crop selection and soil management.

articleTitle: Improving the Efficiency of Electric Vehicle Power Usage through a Fuzzy-based Energy Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Because of the pollution they produce, traditional internal combustion engine cars running on gasoline and diesel are becoming less and less common. The need for cars that don't emit any pollution has grown throughout time. Electric cars are one kind of vehicle that emits less pollution (EV’s). Studies on these cars' energy management, torque control, speed control, and other features are still under progress. Given the rising demand for energy, worries about environmental sustainability, and the requirement for effective resource usage, energy management is an essential part of modern life. Among the numerous benefits of the fuzzy-based energy management system are its dependability and ease of setup. There are two or more power sources in a hybrid electric vehicle. The Energy Management System (EMS), which is governed by fuzzy logic, provides a methodical command for controlling energy in electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Detecting Brain Neuronal Movements Using Histogram of Oriented Gradients
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: In recent years, artificial intelligence has been applied to problems in medical imaging, and in particular to medical imaging of the central nervous system. Many AI & ML innovations include image quality and automatic classification of disease. In this, the movement of neurons in our brain is detected. And if there are any deviations from their usual behavior, this suggests that the person has a brain disorder. These deviations are observed by mapping with normal human brain images. The Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) technique is used to convert the MR image to a graph, which is then compared to a normal brain graph. This algorithm is also used in computer vision and image processing for object detection. And Support Vector Machine (SVM), a Binary classification algorithm is used for classifying the images.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based VGG16, VGG19, and ResNet Models for Grapevine Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Identifying grape plant disease is very important to keep the vineyard healthy and make sure we can grow good grapes. This study looks into using deep learning models like VGG16, VGG19 and ResNet to automatically find out problems in grapevine health. The models were trained on a wide set of 9027 images from Kaggle. These pictures showed different types of disease, including powdery mildew and downy mildew among others. We used a learning rate of 0.01 to help the model come together during training faster. The results show that all three models work very well in finding grapevine diseases. VGG19 was the best one, reaching a correct rate of 98.39% at stage number 24. This better performance comes from its more complex design, allowing it to catch complicated disease parts. VGG16 also did very well, reaching 93.46% correctness, while ResNet had a strong accuracy of 89.33%. The results show that using machine learning deep models can help find grapevine diseases easily. This gives farmers a good tool to manage their vineyards well in advance. The side-by-side look shows the special good points of each design. This study helps to mix artificial intelligence with grape farming. It gives tips that could be helpful in choosing how to handle diseases better. Later research may look at easier ways to understand models, how well they work in different areas where vines grow, and if they can be used for more things. This is important for the grape and wine industry.

articleTitle: Improving Hydrogen Utilization Factor of Fuel Cell Stack Using Perturb and Observe Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: This paper describes a novel approach of optimizing hydrogen fuel flow rate in a fuel cell, in delivering required power output. For controlling this power source (hydrogen) of fuel cell system, Perturb and observe algorithm has been used. In this paper, DC/DC voltage boost converter is used to condition the fuel cell generated power before feeding the DC motor which is used as load for electric vehicle operation. The converter harmonizes the generated electricity with the precise requisites of the designated application. The voltage and current controller have been designed using the Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) algorithm. The system has been tested for delivering controlled power with the optimized rate of hydrogen into the fuel cell. This improves the utilization factor of hydrogen of the fuel cell. This proposed system has been modelled in MATLAB Simulink which proves to be a versatile tool enabling model-based design, simulation, and analysis across diverse engineering disciplines. Its graphical interface, comprehensive library, and capability for automatic code generation are key contributors to its extensive adoption in this paper.

articleTitle: A novel design of Ohmic Transformer Power Supply (OTPS) for Spherical Tokamaks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: Nuclear fusion is one of the few sustainable options to replace fossil fuels as the world's primary energy source, with Deuterium and Tritium as fusion fuels.Thich can be achieved by intersection of fusion science and power electronics in fusion reactors called Tokamak. Spherical Tokamak (ST) are low aspect Ratio Fusion Reactors with promising vital features such as improved plasma stability, better confinement, and higher power output than traditional Tokamaks. Ohmic Transformer Power Supply (OTPS) generates a high current derivative in the Ohmic field coils, which induces emf through transformer action and leads to gas breakdown, plasma current initiation, and plasma current ramp-up by producing sufficient ramp voltage in each stage. This paper proposes a capacitor-based novel design of OTPS in which the coil current slope is controlled using a multilevel H-Bridge topology. IGBTs and Thyristor have been used in this topology as switching devices. The fast controlled discharging of the capacitor has been achieved by switching three cascaded H-Bridge inverters. This will provide plasma initiation in Tokamaks through high di/dt in the range of 3-4 MA/s. The controlled action of coil current is achieved using the digital signal processor (DSP). Low pass LC filter has been used to reduce the ripple in coil current; this increases the complexity but counters the non-uniform loop voltage profile issue. This topology can produce a different loop voltage profile, which can enable to achieve different operational objectives.

articleTitle: Blockchain-based Edge Device Authentication Mechanism in SDN-enabled IoT Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 9th International Conference for Convergence in Technology (I2CT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is a complex network of intelligent and interactive physical devices that exchange data with minimal human intervention. Developing IoT security frameworks is one of the predominant requirements for effectively deploying IoT applications and services. However, IoT devices are resource-constrained and cannot handle the complex algorithms of edge device authentication. Software-defined Networking (SDN) features are advantageous for realizing IoT security frameworks as the data plane is separated from the control plane. The legacy infrastructure can also be integrated with the modern IoT frameworks using SDN. However, the single SDN controller suffers from a single point of failure. To overcome this issue, we proposed a Blockchain-based mechanism to integrate IoT devices with SDN architectures for efficient control and authentication. We considered the fog nodes as SDN controllers and Blockchain nodes, responsible for Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC)-based key generation and refreshment. The IoT devices’ public, private, and shared secret keys are stored on the Blockchain ledger. We leveraged Routing Protocol for Low Power and Lossy Networks (RPL) and Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) for intra (among IoT devices) and inter (among SDN controllers) network communication. The experimental results have proven the efficiency of the Blockchain-based scheme in terms of lower registration and authentication times than the isolated SDN controller-based IoT device registration.
